name: Client runtime Identity account address profile closure
objective: Close client session lifecycle, actor/surface isolation, account/profile/consent/privacy rights, owned address/serviceability and every visible account route on current Identity/DSH truth.
truthOwner: Identity owns sessions; DSH owns client profile, preferences/consents, address and service-area state; Product Truth governs whether privacy-right actions are available.

tasks.objective: Re-prove current Identity/DSH client access semantics and repair only reproduced client-scope defects.
tasks.currentProblem: The previous package treated Identity migration readiness and DSH 401/403 semantics as active defects, but current CI shows Identity and DSH HTTP packages passing while DSH now fails a partner-evidence readiness drift. Keeping stale root causes would cause duplicate or unrelated work.
tasks.requiredChange: Run current client login/refresh/revoke/wrong-role/wrong-surface/readiness tests from exact implementation SHA, remove stale package assumptions, and fix only a currently reproducible Identity or DSH access defect at its canonical owner.
tasks.targetState: Client authentication and authorization are proven on the current governed schema, with no stale planned fix and no import of partner-only readiness work.
tasks.action: Verify current Identity migration/session behavior and DSH client auth semantics first; if green, retain as regression obligation rather than editing working code.
mustNotChange: Do not reintroduce superseded identity-021/022 assumptions.
Do not fix partner evidence migration from this unit.
acceptanceCriteria: Current Identity client session suite passes on active migration set.
No stale package defect is implemented merely because it existed in an older CI artifact.
tasks.rollback: Revert only a new regression; never restore a stale diagnosis as product behavior.
tasks.commitBoundary: Current client access/session owner and direct regressions only.

tasks.currentProblem: Hooks exist but restart, revoke, logout/relogin, offline queues, cached queries and push registrations are not proven together across actor replacement.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace and clear every actor-bound persisted query, queued mutation, pending business attempt, session artifact and push registration on termination/replacement; prove cold restart and offline recovery.
tasks.targetState: No client data, queued write, notification endpoint or pending attempt crosses actor/session boundaries.
tasks.action: Execute lifecycle matrix and fix the first leaking canonical owner rather than adding cache-specific bypasses.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-actor cache/queue is absent after logout/revoke/relogin.
Push is bound only to active actor/surface.
Cold restart does not resurrect previous actor state.
tasks.rollback: Do not restore a proven cross-actor leak.

tasks.objective: Converge owned address, serviceability and location privacy on server truth.
tasks.currentProblem: Local or stale address/serviceability state can split truth between client UI, DSH address owner and service-area owner.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace address CRUD/versioning and geofence evaluation through contracts/database, reject cross-actor access and stale checkout authorization, and remove local eligibility authority.
tasks.targetState: Owned address is privacy-safe and all serviceability decisions are re-evaluated from canonical DSH state.
tasks.action: Repair the first divergent address/geofence owner and add stale/wrong-actor/edge-boundary regressions.

tasks.objective: Close client profile, consent, privacy-right and visible account-route reachability.
tasks.currentProblem: MySpace renders a visible commercial-profile action but DshClientSurface does not provide onOpenProfile or route MyProfileScreen. MyProfileScreen contains real OCC preferences/consents plus disabled data-copy/account-deletion actions, leaving implemented state and privacy affordances unreachable or unresolved.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace DSH client self-service profile GET/PATCH, version conflicts, language/marketing/data-processing consents and privacy-right operations to canonical contracts/handlers. Wire every supported visible action to a governed route; where Product Truth does not authorize a capability, remove the misleading active affordance instead of leaving an inert placeholder. Add cold-reload/409/wrong-actor tests.
tasks.targetState: Every visible account action is reachable and authorized, profile/consents persist with OCC and canonical reload, and data-copy/deletion capability has an explicit governed implementation or explicit non-exposure decision.
tasks.action: Fix route ownership and self-service contract first, then UI wiring; never invent privacy policy in the frontend.
mustNotChange: Do not leave a visible clickable action with no route.
Do not implement data deletion/export semantics without canonical authority.
Do not resolve OCC conflict by silent overwrite.
acceptanceCriteria: Commercial profile action reaches MyProfileScreen or is removed by explicit product disposition.
Profile/consent update is actor-scoped and version-safe with canonical reload.
409 conflict cannot overwrite newer profile state.
Every visible data-copy/account-deletion action has governed end-to-end behavior or is not presented as an available action.
tasks.rollback: Never restore dead navigation or ungoverned privacy actions.
tasks.commitBoundary: Client self-service profile/consent/privacy route and direct backend/frontend tests.
